svg.aria-label: Solution casting: calculate the amount of solution for the target thickness and pour it into a leveled PTFE dish; leave the lid ajar so the solvent evaporates slowly. Thickness t equals solute mass divided by the product of density and area. Vacuum dry to constant weight; residual solvent and moisture make the conductivity falsely high.
